primitives.name: Artifact Production Ledger
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## The rule Any agent that produces, posts, or retires a Nova artifact appends its entry to GROWTH-LEDGER.md (same folder) IN THE SAME RUN, before reporting the work done.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A(t)': 'artifact identifier at time t', 'L(t)': 'ledger entry timestamp', 'S(t)': 'state of artifact (PRODUCED/POSTED/RETIRED)'}
primitives.assumptions: Ledger entries are atomic and synchronous with artifact lifecycle events.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ledger entry fails to precede reporting, artifact is untracked.

layer2.mapping: Each ledger entry maps to a deterministic state transition in GSE's artifact lifecycle engine.

primitives.name: Performance Log Verification
primitives.verbatim_quote: Performance Log — every public post: post URL · platform · retrieval-dated metrics (views, likes, replies/comments, shares/reposts) · notes.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P(u)': 'public post at URL u', 'M(t)': 'retrieval-dated metrics at time t', 'V(t)': 'views at time t', 'L(t)': 'likes at time t', 'R(t)': 'replies/comments at time t', 'S(t)': 'shares/reposts at time t'}
primitives.assumptions: All metrics are retrieved in real-time and logged with timestamps.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Unretrieved metrics are marked 'not retrieved' and not estimated.

layer2.mapping: Performance log serves as kernel for GSI's probabilistic engagement model.

primitives.name: Decision Change Record
primitives.verbatim_quote: Decisions & Changes Log — every change to her voice, style, spec, design, or rules: what changed · who decided (Garrett's decisions only; agents propose, Garrett decides) · where the governing record lives.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D(c)': 'decision change c', 'C(t)': 'change timestamp', 'A(t)': 'agent proposing change', 'G(t)': "Garrett's approval at time t", 'R(c)': 'governing record location'}
primitives.assumptions: Only Garrett can approve changes; all proposals must be logged.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Unauthorized changes invalidate prior logs until re-approved.

layer2.mapping: Change log mirrors GSE's policy update mechanism in decision space.

These form a dual structure where production and performance are tracked atomically, while governance ensures integrity. The ledger enforces causality between actions and records, preventing retroactive or silent corrections. The performance log ensures empirical fidelity by requiring retrieval-based metrics. Decision logs maintain a clear audit trail of authority. Failure modes include asynchronous ledger updates, unverified metrics, and unauthorized changes. The system's robustness stems from its hard boundaries—no public posting without Garrett’s approval—and its requirement for real-time telemetry. This creates a self-consistent, verifiable feedback loop for autonomous agent behavior.
